Feedback Control in a Stirred-Tank Reactor

This Demonstration shows a simple feedback control for a stirred-tank reactor.

Details

Nomenclature:

Tr: reactor temperature (°C)
Tsens: temperature measured by a sensor (°C)
T0: temperature of inlet water (°C)
Tset: setpoint temperature (°C)
Qc: proportional-integral feedback controller model

You can create disturbances in the flow rate and inlet temperature or set the "proportional control constant" slider to 0 to disconnect the controller and observe the temperature response to these changes.

References

[1] I. J. Dunn, E. Heinzle, J. Ingham and J. E. Prvenosil, Biological Reaction Engineering: Dynamic Modelling Fundamentals with Simulation Examples (2nd, completely rev. ed.), Weinheim, Germany: VCH Verlagsgesellschaft mbH, 2003.
